verified.meaning: Built, tested, and run live or on a devnet with measured results

built.meaning: Built and tested with mocks or scripted models; not yet run live

partial.meaning: Part of it is built; the rest is specified

designed.meaning: Specified in detail; no code yet

planned.meaning: Named and scoped; not specified in detail

research.meaning: An open question or experiment; may never ship

areas.CORE: Core protocol: contracts, commit and reveal, agreement, exits
areas.JURY: Juries, live runs, audits and challenges
areas.SETTLE: TinySVM: exact settlement next to the AI
areas.BANK: Routing agent: keyblock, banker, wallet, API router, deposits
areas.PACK: Proof packing and the prompt compressor
areas.SOL: Solana settlement through the three SIMDs
areas.AGENT: Agent plugins and the MCP server
areas.DEPLOY: Deploy and run anywhere: daemon, launcher, clouds, releases, local testnet
areas.CONS: Consensus hardening: jury scheduling, randomness, operators, slashing, payout holds
areas.SIGN: Judiciary Signer, policies and model certification
areas.NET: Harness registry, discovery, pay and attestation
